This suggests that Proparacaine may exert its anesthetic effects by interacting with Scn2a, potentially through a shared mechanism of action. The lowest common ancestor of Proparacaine and Articaine is the class of Anesthetic Agents, and the shared structural feature of Carbonyl Compound further supports a common pharmacological pathway.
